'''Soliss''' was an individual who was on a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that crashed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lehon/Legends|Rakata Prime]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Jedi Civil War]]. The survivors of the crash were taken prisoner by the [[Black Rakata]] tribe, though Soliss learned their [[Rakata (language)|language]] and sought to convince their leader, [[the One]], to let the survivors repair their ship. Soliss hoped to return to his family, including Soliss's love [[Emarka]].
